Dumps the local and main IPv4 routing tables from netlink to stderr.

# Purpose
This file is a small C program that reads IPv4 routing tables from the Linux netlink interface and prints them in a human-readable form. The [`dump_table`](<#dump_table>) function creates an `fd_fib4_t` object in static memory, loads one routing table with `fd_fib4_netlink_load_table`, and writes the result to `stderr` with `fd_fib4_fprintf`. The [`main`](<#main>) function starts the runtime with `fd_boot`, opens a netlink handle, and calls [`dump_table`](<#dump_table>) for `RT_TABLE_LOCAL` and `RT_TABLE_MAIN`. It then closes the netlink handle and stops the runtime with `fd_halt`.
